answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we validate the generated outputs with human evaluation. With each model, we randomly sample 150 outputs from each of the two datasets, total of 300 outputs per model. Given the target style and the original sentence, the annotators are asked to evaluate the model generated sentence with a score range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good) on content preservation, style transfer accuracy, and fluency.
